pretraining: Full-official original MSVR310 DeMo50 bestE32 plus additional50/new Adam; original identity encoder fixed

anchor.method: R201R single final-full-CE-weight factor relative to completed Q MSVR310: 0.25->0.05 only for the first/full deployed5120D classifier objective. The second zero-weight partial CE is not rescaled, auxiliary CE/soft Triplets use the original loss_fn unchanged. Main unit hinge.6, MFaux.01, contribution regression0/task-gate head/sigmoid20/same-state raw targets, cap.10/partial0 forwards/BN2/two backwards, all network/params/FFT/expert/route/PM-PF-PI/5120, originalDeMo42 teacher50 frozen, fresh heads/experts/Adam/seed42/P8K8/orders/augmentations/additional50 stay. Native verifies the observed two-call xent contract and effective coefficient before formal. Config ID_LOSS_WEIGHT.25 remains for auxiliary loss construction; effective final-full coefficient.05 is explicitly logged. Completed Pselected4batch PM/PF CE gradients~3x metric with near-zero positive cosines motivate a controlled test, not proof of harmful CE or Qgradients. Qnormal reg0 gave no+1; do not expand failed seeds. Only MSVR matched ordinary/axis GPU0/1, preserve live P RGB1002/3 and solepaperqueue/K201 best. Full officialtrain/Q/G, earliest normal benchmark-mAP-best same all6/CMC50/perquery/groups/best-last; normal first and paper-six later, no new49, calibrated/causal/global conflict or guaranteedgain claim.
anchor.limits: Common context remains auxiliary; coupled gate is not claimed calibrated. Twelve disjoint-source cases lack shared identity coordinates; missing evaluation deferred.
